correctness.rationale: In the source rank encodings, positive exact rank and exact-one increment are Sigma_2, while zero rank, equality and successor are Pi_1. Replacing the counter test not-equal-to-one by an existential two-witness test on the positive counter domain makes the complete deterministic step relation Sigma_2. The endpoint clauses are then Sigma_3, the universally closed local transition clause is Pi_3, and existential sequence parameters give an effective Sigma_4 halting sentence. The same syntactic profile is present in the source Section 4 LRS-function construction.

originality.rationale: The motivating preprint was checked at the explicit halting formula and the relevant rank-predicate definitions. It states full first-order undecidability for the new function and LRS examples and separately cites the earlier three-block result for two power predicates, but the inspected text gives no finite-prefix bound for the new examples. Targeted web searches and SCOPE archive searches found no matching Sigma_4 refinement. Priority risk remains elevated because the preprint is extremely recent.

value.rationale: The result localises several new natural-structure undecidability theorems to the fixed prefix exists-forall-exists-forall. It applies to Euler totient, sum of divisors, least prime factor via a quantifier-free selector, and the two-dominant-root LRS function construction, sharpening full first-order undecidability into a bounded-alternation statement and isolating the remaining Sigma_3 boundary.
